raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`python/pyproject.toml` pins `sgl-deep-gemm==0.2.3`, but `docker/Dockerfile.cu134` builds DeepGEMM `v0.2.1.post1` and installs it with the pin removed. So the `nightly-cu134-*` images ship `sgl-deep-gemm 0.2.1.post1`.

Muse Spark's MegaMoE path (`muse_spark_megamoe.py`, `forward_megamoe`) passes `post_expert_norm*` arguments that only exist in sgl-deep-gemm 0.2.3+. With `--enable-megamoe-for-layernorm-sp`, the server fails at the first prefill CUDA-graph capture:

```
TypeError: bf16_mega_moe() got an unexpected keyword argument 'post_expert_norm'
```

Reproduce (no GPU needed):

```
docker run --rm lmsysorg/sglang:nightly-cu134-20261020-306ccf6 python3 -c "import importlib.metadata as m, inspect, deep_gemm; print(m.version('sgl-deep-gemm'), [r for r in m.requires('sglang') if 'deep-gemm' in r]); print('post_expert_norm' in inspect.signature(deep_gemm.bf16_mega_moe).parameters)"
# -> 0.2.1.post1+cu134 ['sgl-deep-gemm==0.2.3']
# -> False
```

## Modifications

- Set `DEEPGEMM_REF=v0.2.3` and `SGL_DEEP_GEMM_VERSION=0.2.3` in `docker/Dockerfile.cu134`, matching the pyproject pin and `docker/muse_spark/muse-spark.Dockerfile`, which already builds 0.2.3.
- Add a `check-dockerfile-wheel-pins` pre-commit hook (`scripts/lint/check_dockerfile_wheel_pins.py`). It fails if any Dockerfile under `docker/` sets `DEEPGEMM_REF`, `SGL_DEEP_GEMM_VERSION` or `SGL_DEEP_EP_VERSION` to a value other than the `python/pyproject.toml` pin. These wheels are installed with the pin stripped and `--no-deps`, so a mismatch is otherwise silent. Dockerfiles are found by these ARGs rather than by name, so a renamed or new CUDA Dockerfile stays covered, and the check fails if no Dockerfile sets them. On `main` it reports the current `v0.2.1.post1` mismatch.

<!-- pr-states:start -->
---
### CI States

Latest PR Test (Base): <!-- slot:pr-test:start -->:white_check_mark: [Run #39692879375](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39692879375)<!-- slot:pr-test:end -->
Latest PR Test (Extra): <!-- slot:pr-test-extra:start -->:x: [Run #39692879101](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/39692879101)<!-- slot:pr-test-extra:end -->
Latest PR Test (AMD ROCm 10): <!-- slot:pr-test-amd:start -->:heavy_minus_sign: **No AMD PR run found for this commit**.<!-- slot:pr-test-amd:end -->
<!-- pr-states:end -->

@@ -6,8 +6,8 @@ ARG TORCHVISION_NIGHTLY_VERSION=0.30.0.dev20261005+cu134
 ARG TORCHAUDIO_NIGHTLY_VERSION=2.11.0.dev20261004+cu134
 # Wheel build args
 ARG MANYLINUX_IMAGE=pytorch/manylinuxaarch64-builder:cuda13.4
-ARG DEEPGEMM_REF=v0.2.1.post1
-ARG SGL_DEEP_GEMM_VERSION=0.2.1.post1
+ARG DEEPGEMM_REF=v0.2.3
+ARG SGL_DEEP_GEMM_VERSION=0.2.3
 ARG DEEPEP_SOURCE_REF=sgl-deepep
 ARG SGL_DEEP_EP_VERSION=0.1.2.post1

@@ -0,0 +1,73 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Check that Dockerfiles building pinned wheels from source use the pinned versions.
+
+docker/Dockerfile.cu134 builds sgl-deep-gemm and sgl-deep-ep from source, strips
+their pins from python/pyproject.toml and installs the wheels with --no-deps, so a
+pin bump that misses the Dockerfile ships the old version without any install error.
+Every Dockerfile under docker/ that sets a default for one of the ARGs below is
+checked, so a renamed or newly added CUDA-specific Dockerfile stays covered.
+"""
+
+import glob
+import re
+import sys
+import tomllib
+from collections import defaultdict
+
+PYPROJECT = "python/pyproject.toml"
+
+# Package pinned in pyproject -> {Dockerfile ARG: prefix}; pin X needs ARG=<prefix>X.
+PINNED_ARGS = {
+    "sgl-deep-gemm": {"DEEPGEMM_REF": "v", "SGL_DEEP_GEMM_VERSION": ""},
+    "sgl-deep-ep": {"SGL_DEEP_EP_VERSION": ""},
+}
+
+# `package==X`: the Dockerfiles sed-replace this exact line, so no other form counts.
+_EXACT_PIN = re.compile(r"([\w.-]+)==(\S+)")
+# `ARG NAME=default`, possibly indented.
+_ARG_DEFAULT = re.compile(r"^\s*ARG\s+(\w+)=(.*)$", re.MULTILINE)
+
+
+def arg_defaults() -> dict[str, list[tuple[str, str]]]:
+    """ARG name -> (path, default) for every ``ARG NAME=default`` under docker/."""
+    defaults = defaultdict(list)
+    for path in sorted(glob.glob("docker/**/*Dockerfile*", recursive=True)):
+        with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
+            for name, value in _ARG_DEFAULT.findall(f.read()):
+                defaults[name].append((path, value.strip()))
+    return defaults
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    with open(PYPROJECT, "rb") as f:
+        deps = tomllib.load(f)["project"]["dependencies"]
+    pins = defaultdict(list)  # package -> X of every `package==X` dependency
+    for dep in deps:
+        match = _EXACT_PIN.fullmatch(dep)
+        if match:
+            pins[match.group(1)].append(match.group(2))
+    defaults = arg_defaults()
+
+    errors = []
+    for package, args in PINNED_ARGS.items():
+        if len(pins[package]) != 1:
+            errors.append(f"{PYPROJECT}: expected one exact '{package}==X' pin")
+            continue
+        version = pins[package][0]
+        for arg, prefix in args.items():
+            if not defaults[arg]:
+                errors.append(f"no Dockerfile sets ARG {arg}=...; this check is dead")
+            for path, value in defaults[arg]:
+                if value != prefix + version:
+                    errors.append(
+                        f"{path}: ARG {arg}={value}, expected {prefix}{version} "
+                        f"to match {package}=={version} in {PYPROJECT}"
+                    )
+
+    for error in errors:
+        print(f"ERROR: {error}")
+    return 1 if errors else 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    sys.exit(main())
